import json
import os
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
from scipy import stats

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 10,

})

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

DATA_JSON = os.path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, 'artifacts', 'scatter_v2_data.json')

CATEGORY_STYLE = {
    'Qwen3-8B (canonical)':  {'color': '#1f5fa8', 'marker': 'o', 'size': 90, 'edge': 'white'},

    'Rank ablation':         {'color': '#7b3294', 'marker': 'D', 'size': 55, 'edge': 'white'},
    'Temperature ablation':  {'color': '#e88c2a', 'marker': 'v', 'size': 60, 'edge': 'white'},
    'Qwen3-4B':              {'color': '#1a8f8a', 'marker': 'P', 'size': 65, 'edge': 'white'},

        ax.scatter(
            x[mask], y[mask],
            marker=sty['marker'],
            facecolor=sty['color'],
            edgecolor=sty['edge'],
            linewidth=0.5,
            s=sty['size'],
            alpha=0.88,
            zorder=4,

    ymax = float(y.max()) + 0.30

    annot = f'$\\rho = {rho:.3f}$  ($p = {pval:.2f}$, $n = {n}$)'
    ax.text(0.98, 0.03, annot, transform=ax.transAxes,
            ha='right', va='bottom', fontsize=7.5,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white',
                      edgecolor='#bbbbbb', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.92))

    handles = [
        Line2D([0], [0], marker=sty['marker'], color='w',
               markerfacecolor=sty['color'], markeredgecolor=sty['edge'],
               markeredgewidth=0.5,
               markersize=np.sqrt(sty['size']) * 0.7, label=cat)
        for cat, sty in CATEGORY_STYLE.items()
    ]
    ax.legend(handles=handles, loc='lower center',
              bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 1.01), ncol=4, frameon=False,
              fontsize=6.5, handletextpad=0.25,
              columnspacing=0.7, borderpad=0.0, labelspacing=0.3)

    fig.savefig(os.path.join(HERE, 'fig_degeneracy_lp_scatter.pdf'), format='pdf')
    fig.savefig(os.path.join(HERE, 'fig_degeneracy_lp_scatter.png'), format='png')
    plt.close(fig)
    print(f'Saved fig_degeneracy_lp_scatter.pdf and .png  '
          f'(rho={rho:.3f}, p={pval:.4f}, n={n})')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import os
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',

    'axes.titlesize': 11,

    'xtick.major.size': 3,
    'ytick.major.size': 3,
    'mathtext.fontset': 'dejavusans',
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
})

STYLE = {
    'CoNLL':   {'color': '#228833', 'marker': 's'},
    'SciERC':  {'color': '#EE6677', 'marker': '^'},
    'FewNERD': {'color': '#4477AA', 'marker': 'o'},
}
DATASETS = ['SciERC', 'CoNLL', 'FewNERD']
MODELS = ['Qwen2.5-7B', 'LLaMA-3.1-8B']
LSTYLE = {'Qwen2.5-7B': '-', 'LLaMA-3.1-8B': '--'}

FITS = {
    ('SciERC',  'Qwen2.5-7B'):   {'a': 0.914, 'b': 0.282, 'c': 0.390},
    ('SciERC',  'LLaMA-3.1-8B'): {'a': 0.938, 'b': 0.296, 'c': 0.302},
    ('CoNLL',   'Qwen2.5-7B'):   {'a': 0.972, 'b': 0.099, 'c': 0.839},
    ('CoNLL',   'LLaMA-3.1-8B'): {'a': 0.969, 'b': 0.043, 'c': 0.329},
    ('FewNERD', 'Qwen2.5-7B'):   {'a': 0.957, 'b': 0.251, 'c': 0.612},
    ('FewNERD', 'LLaMA-3.1-8B'): {'a': 0.941, 'b': 0.192, 'c': 0.609},
}

    'SciERC':  [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32],
    'CoNLL':   [1, 2, 4, 8, 16],
    'FewNERD': [1, 2, 4, 8, 16],
}

    ('SciERC',  'LLaMA-3.1-8B'): 0.661,
    ('CoNLL',   'Qwen2.5-7B'):   0.912,
    ('CoNLL',   'LLaMA-3.1-8B'): 0.930,
    ('FewNERD', 'Qwen2.5-7B'):   0.793,
    ('FewNERD', 'LLaMA-3.1-8B'): 0.799,
}

    p = FITS[(ds, model)]
    return p['a'] - p['b'] * np.power(np.asarray(N, dtype=float), -p['c'])

    N_curve = np.geomspace(1, 32, 400)

    # Greedy baselines (mean)
    for ds in DATASETS:
        gy = 0.5 * (GREEDY[(ds, 'Qwen2.5-7B')] + GREEDY[(ds, 'LLaMA-3.1-8B')])
        ax.axhline(y=gy, color=STYLE[ds]['color'], linestyle=':',
                   linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.35, zorder=1)

    # Power-law curves + data points

        color = STYLE[ds]['color']
        marker = STYLE[ds]['marker']
        for model in MODELS:
            ls = LSTYLE[model]
            ax.plot(N_curve, f1_at(ds, model, N_curve),
                    linestyle=ls, color=color, alpha=0.6, linewidth=1.4,
                    zorder=2)
            N_pts = np.array(N_GRID[ds], dtype=float)
            ax.scatter(N_pts, f1_at(ds, model, N_pts),

    ax.set_xscale('log', base=2)
    ax.set_xticks([1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32])
    ax.set_xticklabels(['1', '2', '4', '8', '16', '32'])
    ax.set_xlim(0.85, 38)
    ax.set_ylim(0.60, 1.00)
    ax.set_xlabel(r'Number of Samples ($N$)')
    ax.set_ylabel(r'Oracle $F_1$')
    ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.12, linewidth=0.4, zorder=0)

    # Single unified legend
    handles = []
    for ds in DATASETS:
        handles.append(
            Line2D([0], [0], color=STYLE[ds]['color'],
                   marker=STYLE[ds]['marker'], linestyle='-',
                   linewidth=1.2, markersize=5, markeredgecolor='white',
                   markeredgewidth=0.4, label=ds)
        )
    handles.append(Line2D([0], [0], color='#555555', linestyle='-',
                          linewidth=1.2, label='Qwen2.5-7B'))
    handles.append(Line2D([0], [0], color='#555555', linestyle='--',

    handles.append(Line2D([0], [0], color='#555555', linestyle=':',

    ax.legend(handles=handles, loc='lower right',
              bbox_to_anchor=(0.99, 0.01), frameon=False,
              fontsize=7.5, handlelength=1.8, labelspacing=0.3,
              ncol=2, columnspacing=1.0)

    out_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
    fig.savefig(os.path.join(out_dir, 'fig_oracle_scaling.pdf'), format='pdf')
    fig.savefig(os.path.join(out_dir, 'fig_oracle_scaling.png'), format='png')
    plt.close(fig)
    print('Saved fig_oracle_scaling.pdf and .png')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Generate fig_degeneracy_lp_scatter: LP Selection delta-F1 vs degeneracy rate."""
import json
import os
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
from scipy import stats

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.titlesize': 11,
    'axes.labelsize': 10,
    'xtick.labelsize': 9,
    'ytick.labelsize': 9,
    'legend.fontsize': 8,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.08,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.5,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.8,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.8,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.8,
    'xtick.major.size': 3,
    'ytick.major.size': 3,
    'mathtext.fontset': 'dejavusans',
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
})

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
PROJECT_ROOT = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(HERE, '..', '..', '..'))
DATA_JSON = os.path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, 'artifacts', 'scatter_v2_data.json')

CATEGORY_STYLE = {
    'Qwen3-8B (canonical)':  {'color': '#1f5fa8', 'marker': 'o', 'size': 90, 'edge': 'white'},
    'Qwen3-8B (multi-seed)': {'color': '#9fc1e6', 'marker': 'o', 'size': 50, 'edge': 'white'},
    'LLaMA3.1-8B':           {'color': '#d8553b', 'marker': 's', 'size': 60, 'edge': 'white'},
    'Epoch ablation':        {'color': '#3aa757', 'marker': '^', 'size': 65, 'edge': 'white'},
    'Rank ablation':         {'color': '#7b3294', 'marker': 'D', 'size': 55, 'edge': 'white'},
    'Temperature ablation':  {'color': '#e88c2a', 'marker': 'v', 'size': 60, 'edge': 'white'},
    'Qwen3-4B':              {'color': '#1a8f8a', 'marker': 'P', 'size': 65, 'edge': 'white'},
}

CATEGORY_MAP = {
    'cross-dataset': 'Qwen3-8B (canonical)',
    'multi-seed':    'Qwen3-8B (multi-seed)',
    'LLaMA3.1-8B':   'LLaMA3.1-8B',
    'epoch':         'Epoch ablation',
    'rank':          'Rank ablation',
    'temperature':   'Temperature ablation',
    'Qwen3-4B':      'Qwen3-4B',
}


def main():
    with open(DATA_JSON) as f:
        rows = json.load(f)

    x = np.array([r['degen_pct'] for r in rows])
    y = np.array([r['lp_delta_pp'] for r in rows])
    cats = [CATEGORY_MAP[r['category']] for r in rows]

    rho, pval = stats.spearmanr(x, y)
    n = len(rows)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.4, 2.8))
    fig.patch.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')
    ax.set_facecolor('#F5F7FA')
    for spine in ['bottom', 'left']:
        ax.spines[spine].set_color('#CCCCCC')
        ax.spines[spine].set_linewidth(0.8)
    ax.tick_params(colors='#555555', which='both')
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.15, linewidth=0.5, color='#888888')
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)

    ax.axhline(y=0, color='#888888', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.5, zorder=1)

    for disp_cat, sty in CATEGORY_STYLE.items():
        mask = np.array([c == disp_cat for c in cats])
        if not mask.any():
            continue
        ax.scatter(
            x[mask], y[mask],
            marker=sty['marker'],
            facecolor=sty['color'],
            edgecolor=sty['edge'],
            linewidth=0.5,
            s=sty['size'],
            alpha=0.88,
            zorder=4,
            label=disp_cat,
        )

    ax.set_xlabel('Degeneracy Rate (%)')
    ax.set_ylabel(r'LP Selection $\Delta F_1$ (pp)')

    xmin = max(0, x.min() - 4)
    xmax = min(100, x.max() + 4)
    ax.set_xlim(xmin, xmax)
    ymin = float(y.min()) - 0.25
    ymax = float(y.max()) + 0.30
    ax.set_ylim(ymin, ymax)

    annot = f'$\\rho = {rho:.3f}$  ($p = {pval:.2f}$, $n = {n}$)'
    ax.text(0.98, 0.03, annot, transform=ax.transAxes,
            ha='right', va='bottom', fontsize=7.5,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.35', facecolor='white',
                      edgecolor='#CCCCCC', linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.95))

    handles = [
        Line2D([0], [0], marker=sty['marker'], color='w',
               markerfacecolor=sty['color'], markeredgecolor=sty['edge'],
               markeredgewidth=0.5,
               markersize=np.sqrt(sty['size']) * 0.7, label=cat)
        for cat, sty in CATEGORY_STYLE.items()
    ]
    ax.legend(handles=handles, loc='lower center',
              bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 1.01), ncol=4,
              fontsize=6.5, handletextpad=0.25,
              columnspacing=0.7, borderpad=0.0, labelspacing=0.3,
              frameon=True, fancybox=True, edgecolor='#CCCCCC',
              facecolor='#FAFAFA', framealpha=0.95)

    fig.savefig(os.path.join(HERE, 'fig_degeneracy_lp_scatter.pdf'), format='pdf')
    fig.savefig(os.path.join(HERE, 'fig_degeneracy_lp_scatter.png'), format='png')
    plt.close(fig)
    print(f'Saved fig_degeneracy_lp_scatter.pdf and .png  '
          f'(rho={rho:.3f}, p={pval:.4f}, n={n})')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
